name: Dynamic Compute Control Plane & Workload Routing
purpose: Distributed worker clustering, zero-cost compute routing, device capability negotiation, and multi-node state synchronization.
registration: ControlPlane::register_worker registers cluster nodes; AutoConnectSyncEngine::connect; DeviceCapabilityDetector::detect builds live DeviceProfile on startup; ProjectLinkEngine::build_full_index maps all code relationships.
discovery: WorkerNodeRegistry tracks heartbeat pings and GPU memory availability; DeviceCapabilityDetector::detect probes live hardware capabilities; ProjectLinkEngine resolves symbols and in/out links.
execution: WorkloadDistributor::route_task dispatches computation to optimal available worker based on DeviceProfile; ProjectLinkEngine reconciles code deltas on file events.
memory_link: Worker cluster state synced with centralized memory hub.
learning_link: Heavy training tasks distributed to high-VRAM cluster workers; DeviceProfile selects CUDA or CPU backend.
self_evolution_link: Model weights distributed across cluster shards during expansion; LoadingPolicyEngine selects optimal model loading strategy from DeviceProfile; ProjectLinkEngine tracks code evolution links.
curriculum_link: Curriculum batches partitioned across available compute nodes.
safety_gates: Zero user compute cost mandate: tasks executed strictly on authorized local/cluster nodes
Worker authentication tokens required before joining execution mesh
DeviceCapabilityDetector detects GPU availability at runtime — no hardcoded device assumptions
ProjectLinkEngine validates relationship graph and triggers atomic rollback on corrupted links
GitHubAdapter enforces POSIX paths, unblocked CI, zero compiler warnings, and zero secrets before GitHub push

lifecycle.0_detect: DeviceCapabilityDetector::detect probes live CPU, GPU arch, VRAM, and supported backends
lifecycle.1_heartbeat: Worker nodes submit capability profile (CPU, VRAM, GPU arch) via DeviceProfile
lifecycle.2_register: ControlPlane registers node in dynamic cluster topology
lifecycle.3_dispatch: WorkloadDistributor receives task and evaluates compute requirements
lifecycle.4_route: Route inference/training workload to optimal node with lowest latency and best DeviceProfile match
lifecycle.5_monitor: Monitor task execution and re-route on worker failure
lifecycle.6_sync: AutoConnectSyncEngine syncs resulting weights and logs across cluster
